why: The brief itself says the step is too wide to specify line by line. Commits 2 and 3 tell the model to 'read how thumbnail is made and do the same', 'follow thumb to its storePicture() call', 'wherever a duplicated store's library row gets its url … rewritten' across about fourteen server files. That means choices in code it has not been shown: how the store copy (store-copy-media.ts copies commerce.media through its own update and insert) carries a third file, how Compress decides on and removes the old middle copy, and how ai-picture-marks rewrites it. The e2e test also leaves where its fixture files are served ('if e2e has no static folder, put them in public/demo/e2e/').
harm_if_wrong: A missed medium_path in a delete, compress or sandbox purge would leave orphan files in Storage that Usage and limits counts against the owner, and a store copy that copies the column but not the file would serve tiles whose 800 px address is a 404 on 3x phones, and the int tests named do not cover either path.
make_it_cheaper: After reading store-copy-media.ts, media-compress.ts, ai-picture-marks.ts, sandbox.ts and product-import.ts, give commits 2 and 3 the exact lines to change in each, as commit 1 does, and name the fixture folder for the e2e files; with that the rest is cheap-then-review.
brief_problems: store-copy-media.ts copies commerce.media itself (an update at line ~224 and an insert at line ~245 that do not list thumbnail_path), so the 'copy the third file where the two files are copied' instruction has no two-file pattern there to follow.
The rg check after commit 2 names six files that must also name medium_path, but store-copy-media.ts does not name thumbnail_path, so the check would not catch a missed store-copy change.

product-import.ts reaches storePicture through deps.storePicture ?? storeLibraryPicture (line 465), not a direct call, so the commit-3 rg check listing direct callers would not flag it if it were missed.
